## 3. rs-* Ramp Recipe (for a parallel red timeout ramp)

- **Threshold function:** `rateStep(rate)` at **1551–1557**: `>=1 → 4; >=0.9 → 3; >=0.5 → 2; >0 → 1; 0 → 0` (design-record comment 1545–1550).
- **CSS classes** at **322–333**, alpha-stepped tints of one RGB var:
  - `.rs-0` `rgba(var(--c-pass-rgb),.05)` / `--text-2`
  - `.rs-1` `.16` / `--text-1`
  - `.rs-2` `.34` / `--text-1`
  - `.rs-3` `.65` / `--surface-0` (dark-on-light contrast note 326–328: .55 measured ~4.1:1, bumped to .65 for ≥4.5:1 WCAG)
  - `.rs-4` `.85` / `--surface-0`
  - `.rs-na` `rgba(100,116,139,.12)` / `--text-2`
- **Glyph redundancy** (never color alone): `rateGlyph(step)` — check `&#10003;` at step 4, cross `&#10007;` at step 0 (1558–1562).
- **Replication pattern:** define `.to-0…to-4` (or `rs-bad-*`) using a fail-red RGB var — the fail hex family is `#fb7185/#f87171` per the MODEL_COLORS comment (1519–1521); check whether a `--c-fail-rgb` var exists near `--c-pass-rgb` in the `:root` block. Mind the contrast note from 326–328 when picking the high-alpha steps. A timeout-specific step function is needed: timeout rates cluster low, so `rateStep`'s 50/90 break-points read poorly inverted — thresholds should be chosen for the timeout distribution, not reused blind.

## 4. Header-Width Root Cause (Critical-only mode)

- **Cause:** line 2361 — phase headers are `groupShort(g.id)+' '+metricLabel`, i.e. `"P3b Perfect"` → `"P3b Critical-only"` (×5 phase columns). With `white-space:nowrap` on both `.data-table th` (484) and `.lb-table th.lb-th-sort` (360), each header forces its full one-line width, stretching the table.
- **Current th CSS stack:** `.data-table th` 481–485 (uppercase, letter-spacing .3px, nowrap, pointer); `.lb-table th` 357 (`cursor:default`); `.lb-th-sort` 360 (pointer, nowrap, user-select none); hover/active 361–362.
- The long static `cost` header (2377) is the other wide one; the new name `"Relative Test Cost (1x=Opus 4.8)"` is similar length, so wrapping helps it too.

Low-harm but should reset `lbSort` if it equals `"dispatch"`, or remove the branch entirely. Note `lbSortBy` (4070–4078) and `setLbMetric` (4083) re-render in place — no persistence beyond the session, no column-index dependencies anywhere (all key-based).
2. **`hasDispatch` plumbing** (2238) becomes dead along with `critLabel("agent_dispatched")` usage at 2365.
3. **`CRIT_LABELS` doc comment** 1732–1740 cites "the leaderboard Dispatch column tooltip" as a consumer — comment must be updated (the label is still used in deep-dive prose, so the map entry itself stays).
4. **Generator dev-guide contract** — generator line 217: "leaderboard Dispatch tooltip). Forensic surfaces…" inside the dev-guide comment block; needs the same comment edit. The `dispatch_rate`/`dispatch_passed`/`dispatch_total` precompute fields stay (used by P3a deep-dive), so **no generator code change**.
5. **Footnotes:** the lb-foot block (2498–2511) does **not** mention Dispatch — no change needed there for removal. It DOES define "Battery cost" (2500) and "Timed out" (2505–2506) — the cost sentence must be reworded to the new header name.
6. **lbSortBy comment** 4066–4069 enumerates `…dispatch | consistency | cost` — update.
7. **Phase columns unaffected:** the P3a column (`dispatch_compliance_dispatch` per-phase rate) is separate from the Dispatch column and stays.
